description: End-to-end fulfillment workflow for TaaS SASE connectivity services, including design, quoting, ordering, provisioning, policy deployment, monitoring, and rollback.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier for the enterprise customer/tenant

site_id.description: Unique identifier for a customer site or branch

service_request_id.description: Identifier for a high-level SASE service request (design + quote + order)

design_id.description: Identifier for a proposed or approved SASE network design

quote_id.description: Identifier for a commercial quote associated with a design

order_id.description: Identifier for a SASE service order

provisioning_task_id.description: Identifier for a low-level provisioning task

policy_set_id.description: Identifier for a logical set of security and access policies

deployment_id.description: Identifier for a specific deployment of configuration or policies

subscription_id.description: Subscription identifier for the SASE service.

functions.name: create_sase_service_request
functions.description: Create a new SASE service request capturing customer intent, high-level requirements, and target sites.

customer_id.description: Customer initiating the SASE service request

intent.description: Primary intent of the SASE service engagement

requested_services.description: List of high-level SASE capabilities requested

sites.description: Sites or user groups to be covered by this request

site_id.description: Existing site identifier, if already onboarded

site_type.description: Type of location or logical user grouping

critical_applications.description: List of key applications to protect/prioritize

user_count.description: Approximate number of users associated with this site/group

constraints.description: Deployment or commercial constraints provided by the customer

budget_ceiling.description: Optional budget ceiling per month in customer currency

data_residency_requirements.description: Regions or countries where data must remain

source_channel.description: Channel through which the request was initiated

functions.returns: Newly created service_request_id and initial status

functions.name: design_sase_topology
functions.description: Generate or refine a detailed SASE topology design for a given service request.

service_request_id.description: Service request for which to produce a design

design_strategy.description: Approach to use for generating the design

previous_design_id.description: Existing design to refine or clone

cloud_onramp.description: Cloud providers to include for direct onramp

site_overrides.description: Per-site overrides to the global topology preferences

preferred_pop_region.description: Preferred SASE POP region for this site

validation_only.description: If true, only validate that a design is feasible without persisting it

functions.returns: Design summary including design_id, feasibility status, and key topology characteristics

functions.name: check_sase_feasibility
functions.description: Check technical and commercial feasibility for a proposed SASE design across all sites.

design_id.description: Identifier of the design to validate

site_scope.description: Limit feasibility checks to a subset of sites

strict_mode.description: If true, any single site failure makes overall result non-feasible

functions.returns: Feasibility report per site and overall result, including blocking issues and recommended remediations

functions.name: generate_sase_quote
functions.description: Generate a commercial quote for a validated SASE design, including recurring and one-time charges.

design_id.description: Design for which to generate pricing

pricing_model.description: Pricing model to apply for this quote

currency.description: ISO currency code, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP

quote_breakdown_level.description: Level of granularity for quote lines

auto_approve_if_within_budget.description: Automatically mark quote as customer-approved if within budget constraints of the request

functions.returns: Quote details including quote_id, pricing breakdown, and approval status

functions.name: submit_sase_order
functions.description: Submit a SASE service order based on an approved quote, creating provisioning tasks.

quote_id.description: Approved quote to convert into an order

customer_po_reference.description: Customer purchase order reference or internal billing reference

activation_preferences.description: Activation window and phasing for go-live

blackout_periods.description: Time periods where changes must not be made

site_scoping.description: Optional site scoping for partial order creation

auto_create_policy_set.description: Create a baseline policy set based on design and intent

functions.returns: Order summary including order_id, initial order status, and created provisioning_task_ids

functions.name: get_sase_order_status
functions.description: Retrieve detailed status, progress, and issues for a SASE service order and its provisioning tasks.

include.description: Related objects to include in the response

task_filter.description: Filter for provisioning tasks attached to this order

functions.returns: Order status, aggregated progress, and optional details for tasks, sites, policy sets, and related change requests

functions.name: provision_sase_connectivity
functions.description: Trigger or re-trigger provisioning tasks for SASE connectivity at one or more sites.

order_id.description: Associated order for which provisioning is being executed

site_scope.description: Scope of sites to provision or re-provision

task_overrides.description: Overrides for specific provisioning tasks or steps

validate_after_provisioning.description: If true, automatically trigger post-provisioning validation tasks

functions.returns: Updated provisioning_task_ids with new statuses and any tasks scheduled for execution

functions.name: create_or_update_policy_set
functions.description: Create a new policy set or update an existing one for SASE security and access control.

customer_id.description: Customer that owns the policy set

policy_set_id.description: Existing policy_set_id to update; omit to create a new one

metadata.description: High-level metadata about this policy set

scope.description: Logical scope for this policy set

inspection_profile.description: Deep inspection and security controls to apply

change_comment.description: Reason or description for the policy change

validate_only.description: If true, validate policy semantics without persisting

functions.returns: Policy set details including policy_set_id, version, validation results, and whether changes were applied

functions.name: deploy_sase_configuration
functions.description: Deploy SASE configuration and/or policies to designated sites, user groups, or edges.

deployment_scope.description: Scope of what is being deployed

order_id.description: Deploy all configurations and policies associated with this order

user_groups.description: Limit deployment to specific user groups

deployment_strategy.description: Strategy used to roll out configuration changes

schedule.description: Scheduling options when using non-immediate strategies

batch_size.description: Number of sites/users per batch for progressive/canary

auto_rollback_on_failure.description: Automatically roll back if defined failure thresholds are exceeded

failure_thresholds.description: Criteria for treating deployment as failed

functions.returns: Deployment summary including deployment_id, scheduled execution details, and initial state

functions.name: monitor_sase_deployment
functions.description: Monitor the progress, health, and impact of an ongoing or completed SASE deployment.

include.description: Additional details to include in the response

baseline_deployment_id.description: Optional baseline deployment to compare against

functions.returns: Current deployment status, rollout progress, optional per-site details, and key impact metrics

functions.name: request_sase_change
functions.description: Create a change request to modify, cancel, or rollback aspects of an existing SASE service.

impact_scope.description: Scope of impact for this change

requested_action.description: Parameters specific to the requested change

rollback_target_version.description: Target version to rollback to, for deployments/policy sets

reason.description: Business or technical justification for the change

functions.returns: Change request details including change_request_id, approval requirements, and initial status

functions.name: execute_sase_change
functions.description: Execute an approved SASE change request, handling cancel, modify, or rollback logic.

safety_checks.description: Safety checks required before executing the change

override_approvals.description: If true, bypasses approval checks (for emergency use only)

notification_config.description: Who to notify about change execution progress

functions.returns: Execution result including updated change_request status, generated deployment_ids or rollback_ids, and any validation findings

functions.name: search_sase_service_requests
functions.description: Faceted search across SASE service requests with rich filters, time windows, pagination, and aggregations.

facets.description: Facets to compute alongside the result set.

projection.description: Fields to include in the result objects.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A page of SASE service request summaries with facet aggregations, pagination cursor, and optional scoring metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_sase_service_requests
functions.description: Create multiple SASE service requests in a single atomic or best-effort batch with idempotency and partial-commit options.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A bulk-job descriptor with per-item outcomes, created SASE service request ids, error reasons for failures, and an aggregate counts summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_sase_service_requests
functions.description: Apply patch-style updates to many SASE service requests with optimistic concurrency and partial-failure handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-item update outcomes (success/failure with reason), new versions for each SASE service request, and a summary of skipped and quarantined items.

functions.name: bulk_archive_sase_service_requests
functions.description: Archive or soft-delete many SASE service requests in one call with retention, audit reason, and webhook notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id outcome, new lifecycle state for each SASE service request, scheduled purge date if applicable, and a job id for tracking.

functions.name: export_sase_service_requests
functions.description: Export SASE service request datasets to an external sink in CSV, JSON, Parquet, or NDJSON with filters and signed-URL delivery.

split_by.description: Field to shard output by, e.g., tenant_id.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with job id, estimated row count, signed-URL(s) when applicable, and asynchronous completion event details.

functions.name: import_sase_service_requests
functions.description: Bulk-import SASE service request records from a file or staging table with schema mapping, validation, and quarantine handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An import job descriptor with counts of valid, invalid, and quarantined rows, sample error messages, and identifiers of created or updated SASE service requests.

functions.name: subscribe_to_sase_service_request_events
functions.description: Register a webhook or message-bus subscription to receive SASE service request lifecycle events with filtering and retry policy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created subscription record with id, secret rotation hint, active state, and an example test-event payload for the SASE service request.

functions.name: get_sase_service_request_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the immutable audit trail for a SASE service request, including who changed what, when, and from which channel.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A chronologically ordered list of audit entries for the SASE service request, each with actor, action, before/after diff, source, and optional evidence links.

functions.name: schedule_recurring_sase_service_request_job
functions.description: Create or update a recurring job for SASE service requests using cron, ISO interval, or calendar windows with backfill and concurrency controls.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated schedule descriptor with id, next run time, effective cron, and any backfill plan summary for the SASE service request action.

functions.name: simulate_sase_service_request_changes
functions.description: Preview the effect of a proposed change to a SASE service request without persisting, returning a diff and impact analysis.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A simulation report showing the resulting state of the SASE service request, a structured diff, policy-check verdicts, and a quantitative impact estimate (cost, latency, blast radius).

functions.name: request_sase_service_request_approval
functions.description: Create an approval workflow request for a SASE service request change, with multi-stage approvers, SLA, and evidence attachments.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An approval-request descriptor with id, current stage, list of pending approvers, SLA deadlines, and links to the SASE service request under change.

functions.name: decide_sase_service_request_approval
functions.description: Record an approver decision (approve, reject, request changes) on a pending SASE service request approval request.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

expected_stage.description: Optimistic concurrency check on the approval stage.

functions.returns: The updated approval-request state including new stage, list of completed and pending approvers, and any condition list applied to the SASE service request.

functions.name: add_sase_service_request_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment, mention, or note to a SASE service request for collaboration and case-management context.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted comment record with id, threading info, visibility, mention/notification fan-out summary for the SASE service request.

functions.name: upload_sase_service_request_attachment
functions.description: Upload or link a binary attachment (evidence, log bundle, screenshot, contract) to a SASE service request with scanning and retention.

inline_data.description: Base64 payload when kind is inline_base64.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created attachment record with id, scan verdicts, signed download URL, checksum, and link to the SASE service request.

functions.name: create_sase_service_request_snapshot
functions.description: Capture an immutable point-in-time snapshot of a SASE service request (state, configuration, dependencies) for audit or rollback.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A snapshot record with id, size, checksum, encryption metadata, and a reference to the SASE service request version captured.

functions.name: restore_sase_service_request_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a SASE service request from a snapshot with selectable scope, validation pre-checks, and notification on completion.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A restore-operation descriptor with operation id, pre-restore snapshot id, validation results, conflict resolutions applied, and final state of the SASE service request.

functions.name: get_sase_service_request_metrics
functions.description: Compute and return KPI/metrics aggregates for SASE service requests over a time window with grouping, filters, and percentiles.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A metrics result with aggregate values, percentiles, optional period-over-period deltas, sparkline series per group, and the SASE service request domain context.

functions.name: get_sase_service_request_dashboard
functions.description: Return a pre-composed dashboard view for SASE service requests combining KPIs, alerts, top offenders, and time series.

personalize_for.description: User id to personalize widgets for.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A dashboard payload with KPI tiles, time-series data, top offenders, active alerts, and personalization metadata for the SASE service request context.

functions.name: create_sase_service_request_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule applied to SASE service requests with versioning, scope, and rollout strategy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated policy record with id, version, rollout plan, scope, and an effective-evaluation summary against current SASE service requests.

functions.name: evaluate_sase_service_request_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a SASE service request in dry-run, returning per-rule verdicts and proposed actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-policy and per-rule verdicts with reasons, trace data, and a list of proposed (or applied, when apply_actions=true) actions against the SASE service request.

functions.name: get_sase_service_request_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the upstream and downstream dependency graph for a SASE service request including services, devices, tickets, and contracts.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A graph payload (nodes, edges, optional health and metrics) describing dependencies for the SASE service request, with depth and direction respected.

functions.name: link_sase_service_request_to_related
functions.description: Create or remove an association between a SASE service request and another business object (incident, ticket, contract, asset).

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The resulting association record (or removal confirmation) including direction, relation type, and a snapshot of the related-object summary for the SASE service request.

functions.name: assign_sase_service_request_owner
functions.description: Assign or reassign ownership/roles on a SASE service request with hand-off rules, watchers, and notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The updated assignment roster for the SASE service request with effective windows, hand-off receipts, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: tag_sase_service_requests
functions.description: Apply, remove, or replace tags and labels on one or more SASE service requests, with conflict resolution and audit.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id tag-application outcomes with final tag sets and counts of added/removed/skipped operations for each SASE service request.

functions.name: compare_sase_service_request_versions
functions.description: Produce a structured diff between two versions (or snapshots) of a SASE service request with semantic equivalence handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A diff document describing added, removed, and changed fields between the two versions of the SASE service request, with optional side-by-side rendering.

functions.name: configure_sase_service_request_retry_policy
functions.description: Configure default retry, backoff, and circuit-breaker policy applied to SASE service request operations and their downstream actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted retry/circuit-breaker policy with id, effective scope, and a summary of SASE service request operations that match the new policy.

functions.name: check_sase_service_request_health
functions.description: Run a synthetic health/probe sweep against a SASE service request and its critical dependencies and return aggregated health status.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Aggregated health verdict for the SASE service request, per-probe results, dependency roll-up, and any alert notifications dispatched.

functions.name: clone_sase_service_request
functions.description: Clone a SASE service request into a new instance with selective fields, optional rename, and link-back metadata.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The cloned SASE service request record with id, lineage link to the source, and a summary of fields reset, copied, or skipped.

functions.name: generate_sase_service_request_report
functions.description: Generate a formatted SASE service request report (executive, operational, compliance) and deliver via email/object storage.

schedule_id.description: When generated by a recurring schedule.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A report-generation receipt with report id, download URL or delivery confirmation, page/sheet count, and the SASE service request window covered.

functions.name: escalate_sase_service_request
functions.description: Escalate a SASE service request to a higher tier or owner group with reason, severity bump, and watcher fan-out.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The escalation record with new owner/tier, severity, SLA, watchers, and a log of notifications sent for the SASE service request.
